model.description: Provider-native model id passed to the shim

duration_hours.description: User-selected duration; supervisor derives absolute start/deadline timestamps

min_useful_work_minutes.description: Do not start another session if less than this remains before the deadline

scope_boundary.description: Explicit statement of what is in/out of scope for this run

max_cost_usd.description: SOFT threshold: checked between provider calls, may be exceeded by at most one in-flight call. Only enforceable where the provider reports cost (claude); see capability matrix

max_total_tokens.description: SOFT threshold (one-call overshoot possible). Enforceable on claude/codex; kimi/opencode shims do not report tokens

max_provider_calls.description: Provider-independent HARD cap on provider invocations (persisted in run state); REQUIRED for real (non-dry) runs on providers without cost reporting

budget.description: At least one budget is mandatory. Cost/token caps are inter-call soft thresholds; the hard caps are max_provider_calls and the deadline-bounded per-call timeout

provider_risk_acknowledged.description: Explicit human acknowledgment required for real runs where declared policies are not provider-enforceable (kimi advisory permissions; offline/allowlist network on providers without egress enforcement)

note.description: Enforcement depends on provider capability (see capability matrix); the supervisor records intent and passes it to the shim

heartbeat_seconds.description: Cadence of run-state heartbeat/checkpoint writes while a provider call is in flight

checkpoint_interval_minutes.description: Upper bound on time between checkpoints; state is additionally checkpointed at every transition and heartbeat

kill_switch_file.description: Plain file name relative to the run dir (no path separators, no leading dot); existence triggers a stop that also interrupts an in-flight provider call
